name: native aft creation contract
aft_creation:
assert(frozen:GetTexture() == nil and unused:GetTexture() == nil)
for _, method in ipairs({'EnableAlphaBuffer', 'EnableDepthBuffer', 'EnableFloat', 'EnablePreserveTexture'}) do
 assert(not pcall(function() frozen[method](frozen) end))
 for _, value in ipairs({0, 1, 'true', {}}) do assert(not pcall(function() frozen[method](frozen, value) end)) end
end
assert(not pcall(function() frozen:SetTextureName(false) end))
frozen:setsize(0.75, 1)
assert(pcall(function() assert(frozen:Create() == frozen) end))
assert(frozen:GetTexture() == nil)
frozen:setsize(65.75, 33.5):SetTextureName('temp/../FrozenCapture'):EnableAlphaBuffer(true):EnableDepthBuffer(true):EnableFloat(true):Create()
local retained = frozen:GetTexture()
assert(retained == frozen:GetTexture())
assert(retained:GetPath() == 'FrozenCapture' and retained:GetSourceWidth() == 65 and retained:GetSourceHeight() == 33)
frozen:setsize(17, 9):SetTextureName('RequestedName'):EnableAlphaBuffer(false):EnableDepthBuffer(false):EnableFloat(false)
assert(frozen:GetTexture():GetPath() == 'FrozenCapture' and retained:GetSourceWidth() == 65 and retained:GetSourceHeight() == 33)
assert(pcall(function() assert(frozen:Create() == frozen) end))
collision:setsize(32, 16):SetTextureName('FrozenCapture'):Create()
assert(collision:GetTexture() == nil)
collision:SetTextureName(123):Create()
assert(collision:GetTexture():GetPath() == '123')
assert(retained:GetImageWidth() == 65 and retained:GetImageHeight() == 33)
unused:SetTextureName(''):Create()
assert(unused:GetTexture():GetPath() == '' and unused:GetTexture():GetSourceWidth() == 1 and unused:GetTexture():GetSourceHeight() == 1)
